name: Trading on material non-public information (flagged: illegal, survey only)
one_line: Insiders with military, corporate or script knowledge demonstrably trade Polymarket; others detect their on-chain fingerprint to follow, pull quotes or sell alerts.
scope: Survey only. Document that it happens and what happened to the people: cases and enforcement (DOJ / CFTC prosecutions 2026, Maduro-operation soldier, Israeli officers, Google Year-in-Search, OpenAI, teleprompter operator), scale estimates, Polymarket's policy and surveillance, the legal basis, and why it matters to an honest builder: it is the adverse-selection counterparty in geopolitics / mentions / corporate markets and must be priced into every maker and longshot-selling strategy. No how-to. Boundary: detecting and reacting to such flow is whale-informed-flow-tracking.

parent_scope: Survey-level for the illegal part, build-level for detection. Cover documented cases and enforcement (Maduro operation soldier ~$410k, Israeli officers, Google Year-in-Search 22/23, OpenAI firing, teleprompter operator), scale estimates (~$143M flagged gains, 210k wallet-market pairs ~70% win; ACDC 556 Orcas, 152 military wallets 97.2%), the fingerprint (fresh wallet, single market family, conviction size at tiny prices, funder clusters), academic screens (lifecycle heuristic t=8.65 on outcome, ILS computable in 0.7% of markets, counter-evidence of zero pre-event leakage), follower economics (copycat bot $200k, being exit liquidity, practitioner failure), use as a maker toxicity trigger in fee-free geopolitics, and the alert-service variant that triggered Polymarket's builder audit. Boundary: PnL-based copying is screened-copy-trading; outcome manipulation is oracle-input-manipulation.
critic_notes: SPLIT informed-flow-and-insider-trading into (a) MNPI insider trading (survey only, prohibited, Established) and (b) informed-flow detection used as fast-follow, quote-pull trigger or alert product (grey, Emerging at best: the cited paper did not test following and the practitioner 'did not succeed'). One file with one maturity label hides that the buildable half is unproven.

informed-flow-and-insider-trading: a single 'Established' label covers an illegal practice that is established and a detection / fast-follow build that is Emerging at best. Two labels are needed even if the file stays merged.

raw_discovery_candidates.name: Trading on material non-public information (insiders in military, corporate and platform roles)
raw_discovery_candidates.one_line: People with classified or corporate inside knowledge bet on Polymarket; academics estimate ~$143M of suspicious gains, and several have been arrested, charged or fired.
raw_discovery_candidates.mechanism: Survey level only. Documented pattern: a new wallet funded days before an event, concentrated in one market, large conviction, dormant after resolution. Cases in 2026 include a US special-forces soldier (Maduro operation, ~$410k, DOJ indictment 2026-04-23), Israeli air-force personnel (one earned $244k; charged), an OpenAI employee (fired) and a Google engineer (accused, WSJ 2026-05-30). Detection used lifecycle heuristics, order-imbalance tests and cross-referencing on-chain PnL with indictments.

evidence.supports: ~$143M aggregate realised gains among statistically flagged suspicious trades; flagged traders win ~70% of resolved cases; authors argue current fraud frameworks fit poorly and propose surveillance and registration reforms.

evidence.title: Per-Market Information Leakage and Order-Flow Skill (Nechepurenko), arXiv
evidence.supports: On-chain PnL of the flagged lead account ($409,882.03) matches the DOJ indictment figure ($409,881) for the Venezuela operation case.

raw_discovery_candidates.name: Trading on material non-public information
raw_discovery_candidates.one_line: People with advance knowledge (military, corporate, production staff) bet before the news.
raw_discovery_candidates.mechanism: Survey level. The highest win rates on-chain belong to wallets that appear to know outcomes: soldiers before operations, an engineer before product announcements, staff who see a speech before it is given. They typically use new wallets, size up within an hour and target long-shot prices. Detection now comes from NGOs, academics and the platform's own surveillance, and enforcement has started.
raw_discovery_candidates.why_might_beat_market: Included because it explains a large share of 'unbeatable' leaderboard wallets and is the main adverse-selection risk for market-making agents in geopolitics, mentions and corporate-event markets.

raw_discovery_candidates.name: Insider-cluster / fresh-wallet detection and following
raw_discovery_candidates.one_line: Flag new or narrowly specialised wallets making conviction-sized bets at tiny prices in one market family, and trade with them (or pull quotes).
raw_discovery_candidates.mechanism: Fingerprint from a reconstructed DOJ case: a Google employee's wallet went 22/23 (+~$1.2M) on 'Year in Search' markets with entries as low as 3c while being a net loser on 69 other markets - the signal appears only when PnL is segmented by market family. Practitioner detectors look for fresh wallets, first/second-ever trades of $10-40k, funding-graph clusters (one funder -> 7,200+ proxy wallets) and geopolitical timing (Venezuela: ~$35k -> ~$400k in 6 h; an Iran/Lebanon wallet 11/11). For a market maker the same detector is a quote-pull trigger.
raw_discovery_candidates.edge_source: Public on-chain footprints of non-public information.
raw_discovery_candidates.why_might_beat_market: Occasionally enormous asymmetry (3c entries); geopolitics is fee-free.
raw_discovery_candidates.failure_modes: Insiders sweep the book so followers get bad prices; decoys/countersignals; an HN practitioner built a detector and 'did not succeed'; base rate of false positives is high; enforcement is rising (DOJ charges May 2026; CFTC investigation and '150 wallets' research are headlines only).
raw_discovery_candidates.cheap_validation: Backtest the fingerprint on known cases (Google, Venezuela, Iran) and on a random month; measure price available 60 s after the flagged trade and hit rate.
raw_discovery_candidates.flags: Knowingly trading alongside suspected MNPI is legally grey and on the CFTC-regulated venue may create liability; insiders themselves have been criminally charged (Google engineer, Israeli air-force officers).

raw_discovery_candidates.name: Informed-flow detection and following (fresh single-market wallets, large-trade imbalance)
raw_discovery_candidates.one_line: Screen in real time for the on-chain signature of informed accounts - new wallet, one event, high conviction - and trade with their order imbalance before the price fully adjusts.
raw_discovery_candidates.mechanism: Maintain wallet lifecycle features (age < 7 days, single-event concentration, size, funding source) and per-market signed imbalance from on-chain fills. When flagged-account imbalance appears, enter in the same direction and hold to the information event; the published heuristic's imbalance predicts next-period price change (t=2.54) and final outcome (t=8.65). A complementary post-hoc Information Leakage Score measures how much of the terminal move was priced before public news, useful for choosing categories (military/geopolitics) where leakage is recurrent.
raw_discovery_candidates.edge_source: Public, pseudonymous, real-time ledger of who is trading - something no traditional market offers.
raw_discovery_candidates.why_might_beat_market: Most wallet trackers rank by past PnL (which excludes one-shot insiders by construction); the lifecycle screen targets exactly the accounts leaderboards miss.

evidence.title: Per-Market Information Leakage and Order-Flow Skill: Two Methodological Lenses on Informed Trading in Decentralized Prediction Markets (Nechepurenko), arXiv
evidence.supports: Lifecycle heuristic flags 1,950 accounts with mean realised profit $15,012.92 (median $2,758.29); flagged imbalance predicts next-period price (t=2.54) and final outcome (t=8.65); the lead flagged account in the Maduro cluster shows PnL $409,882.03, matching the DOJ-indicted figure of $409,881; cluster total $626,484.29 over 77 markets traded Dec-27-2025..Jan-2-2026; the paper does not test whether following is profitable.

evidence.title: From Iran to Taylor Swift: Informed Trading in Prediction Markets (Mitts, Ofir), SSRN via Crossref abstract
evidence.supports: Screen of 210,000+ wallet-market pairs (Feb-2024..Feb-2026): flagged traders profit in ~70% of resolved cases; ~$143M aggregate realised gains on suspicious trades.

evidence.title: Empirical Evaluation of Deadline-Resolved Information Leakage on Documented Polymarket Insider Cases (Nechepurenko), arXiv
evidence.supports: Counter-evidence on timing: in the $269M 'US forces enter Iran by April 30' market only ~11% of the move preceded the public event and 30-min/2-h pre-event leakage was exactly zero; only 88 of 12,708 markets (0.7%) yield computable leakage scores.

evidence.title: Wikipedia: Polymarket (citing FT/ACDC, WSJ)
evidence.supports: Anti-Corruption Data Collective via FT (2026-04-30): 52% of military long-shot bets ($2,500+, odds <=35%) succeeded vs 25% in politics and 14% overall; WSJ (2026-05-04): ~3% of traders account for most price discovery.

raw_discovery_candidates.failure_modes: Unknown precision (sybils, promo accounts, viral newcomers all look alike); decoy wallets; you are last in a fast queue; most markets show no measurable leakage; platform now freezes/bans accounts.
raw_discovery_candidates.cheap_validation: Event-study on historical on-chain data: enter at the next trade after a flagged account's cumulative position crosses $X, exit at resolution; report hit rate and return net of spread by category.
raw_discovery_candidates.flags: Legal/ethical grey zone: knowingly trading alongside suspected MNPI flow; CFTC/DOJ attention is high (indictment 2026-04-23). Not itself insider trading, but counsel-worthy.

raw_discovery_candidates.name: Insider-signal ('Orca') detection and fast-follow
raw_discovery_candidates.one_line: Detect fresh wallets making concentrated long-shot bets in sensitive markets and follow within minutes.
raw_discovery_candidates.mechanism: A detector flags wallets that place at least $2,500 within an hour on an outcome priced at 35% or less, especially new wallets in military/geopolitical markets (which are fee-free). ACDC found 556 such 'Orca' wallets; 152 military-focused ones won 97.2% of the time for $8M. On-chain data shows bots and whales already pile in behind them, sometimes with six-figure size. This differs from leaderboard copy trading: the signal is behavioural anomaly, not historical PnL. Academic 'information leakage score' work gives a quantitative version.
raw_discovery_candidates.edge_source: Public ledger reveals informed flow in real time; geopolitics markets have zero taker fee.
raw_discovery_candidates.why_might_beat_market: If the first mover truly has MNPI, the second mover still buys far below terminal value. But followers are now numerous and quick, and the first mover can sell to them.

evidence.title: Exclusive: More than 150 Polymarket wallets may have traded on military secrets (Reuters via Al-Monitor)
evidence.supports: ACDC method and numbers: 556 Orcas, 152 military, $8M, 97.2% win rate, data through 2026-05-05; copycat bot $200k and whale $100k after Iran-strike bet (June 2025); Polymarket says it referred dozens of wallets to authorities.

evidence.title: arXiv listing: ForesightFlow / Information Leakage Score papers (Nechepurenko, 2605.00493, 2605.02286, 2605.00459)
evidence.supports: Listing-level only: ILS framework quantifies the share of the terminal move priced before public news; at population scale only 0.7% of 12,708 markets yield a computable score, i.e. clean signals are rare.

evidence.title: 'Informed' traders on Polymarket netted $143 million in 'anomalous' profit since 2024 (Business Insider) - snippet only
evidence.supports: Snippet: first estimate of suspicious-account profits, $143M 2024-2026. Body not fetchable.

raw_discovery_candidates.failure_modes: False positives (rich gamblers); being exit liquidity; legal exposure if one knowingly trades alongside leaked classified information; markets may be voided or restricted (Polymarket limited sensitive markets in March 2026); House Oversight probe (May 2026) and three federal investigations reported by Wired (snippet).
raw_discovery_candidates.cheap_validation: Backtest the ACDC rule on the public trade archive: for each trigger, measure price 10 min / 1 h / at resolution after the trigger, net of the follower's likely fill.
raw_discovery_candidates.flags: Legal grey: knowingly following suspected MNPI; reputational and regulatory risk. Not ToS-violating per se.

raw_discovery_candidates.name: Insider / unusual-activity alert service (retail)
raw_discovery_candidates.one_line: Real-time alerts on fresh wallets making large, concentrated, low-probability bets. There is strong demand, but it is now the feature Polymarket audits builders over.
raw_discovery_candidates.mechanism: Stream on-chain fills and score them on wallet age, deposit size, position concentration, entry price under 15%, volume spikes in quiet markets, and wallet clustering. Push alerts to Telegram, SMS or email with a trade link carrying your builder or referral code. Kreo bundles an "Unusual Activity Tracker", and Presage is a dedicated product in a waitlist stage.
raw_discovery_candidates.edge_source: Speed of on-chain anomaly detection before the price moves.
raw_discovery_candidates.why_might_beat_market: Documented insider episodes in 2026 (Iran strikes, the Maduro operation, Google Year-in-Search) did show fresh-wallet signatures before moves. Academic work shows the detectable domain is narrow.

evidence.title: Presage
evidence.supports: Six detectors and Telegram, SMS and email alerts. It is a waitlist with "free tier at launch" and no traction data.

evidence.title: Information Leakage at Population Scale (arXiv API listing)
evidence.supports: A deadline-ILS framework scaled to 12,708 markets yields computable values for only 0.7% of them.

evidence.title: The Data Behind the Google Polymarket Insider
evidence.supports: An on-chain reconstruction: 22 of 23 wins on insider markets at about 3c average entry, and losses on the other 69 markets. It matches DOJ figures within 1%.

evidence.title: Polymarket Audits Builders Program Startups
evidence.supports: "Find insiders before everyone else" marketing triggered a platform audit.

raw_discovery_candidates.failure_modes: False positives dominate. Once it is widely sold the signal is front-run within seconds. Platform de-listing is a risk. Law enforcement is now prosecuting insiders (DOJ and CFTC cases in 2026), which reduces how often insiders trade.
raw_discovery_candidates.cheap_validation: Backtest the detectors on the 2026 documented cases plus 6 months of fills. Measure precision and the post-alert price path net of fees.
raw_discovery_candidates.flags: GREY: facilitating trading alongside suspected holders of material non-public information. Polymarket's March 2026 integrity rules and the builder audit apply. Frame the product as surveillance and research, never as "trade with insiders".
